title: Reproduce duplicate durable write before patch
preconditions: Use the bound repository revision and controlled test environment.
command_or_method: Run concurrent equivalent approval requests against the pre-patch revision.
expected_result: At least one controlled run demonstrates two committed durable rows for one intent.

title: Validate additive migration
preconditions: Use the bound repository revision and controlled test environment.
command_or_method: Apply the expansion migration to a representative schema snapshot.
expected_result: Migration succeeds without requiring old writers to populate the new columns.

title: Validate data and constraint migration gates
preconditions: Use the bound repository revision and controlled test environment.
command_or_method: Run duplicate assessment, safe backfill, and constraint dry run.
expected_result: Ambiguous rows are reported; safe rows backfill; constraint activation fails closed until prerequisites pass.

title: Repository atomic insert integration
preconditions: Use the bound repository revision and controlled test environment.
command_or_method: Run repository integration tests against a real database.
expected_result: One insert wins and equivalent conflicts resolve to the same committed row.

title: Concurrent equivalent request invariant
preconditions: Use the bound repository revision and controlled test environment.
command_or_method: Run concurrent equivalent requests from separate connections or processes.
expected_result: Exactly one durable row commits and all callers observe one business result.

title: Changed payload idempotency conflict
preconditions: Use the bound repository revision and controlled test environment.
command_or_method: Reuse one key with a different payload fingerprint.
expected_result: Request fails explicitly as an idempotency conflict and no second durable effect is committed.

title: Existing API contract compatibility

preconditions: Use the bound repository revision and controlled test environment.
command_or_method: Run cross-tenant collision attempts and inspect emitted logs.

title: Historical duplicate preservation
preconditions: Use the bound repository revision and controlled test environment.
command_or_method: Execute migration fixtures containing unambiguous and ambiguous historical rows.

title: Observability signal validation

title: Rollback rehearsal
